useFormatterConfigDefaults.markdownDescription: Whether parent directories and the home directory are also searched for a `.JuliaFormatter.toml` file.

markdownEnumDescriptions: Show completions for the current namespace.
Show completions for the current namespace and unexported variables of `using`ed modules. Selection of an unexported variable will result in the automatic insertion of an explicit `using` statement.

julia.inlayHints.static.enabled.markdownDescription:
Enable display of static inlay hints.

Please note that you also need to enable inlay hints in the LSP package settings (*Preferences: LSP Settings* from the command palette): `"show_inlay_hints": true`

julia.inlayHints.static.variableTypes.en.markdownDescription:
Enable type hints for variable definitions:

```julia
foo #= ::Int64 =# = 42
```

julia.inlayHints.static.parameterNames.e.markdownDescription:
Enable name hints for function parameters:

```julia
foo(#= bar: =# 42)
```

julia.symbolCacheDownload.markdownDescription: Download symbol server cache files from `julia.symbolserverUpstream`.

julia.enableDynamicIndexing.markdownDescription: Whether to use local package indexing. Disable for potentially reduced functionality with lower resource usage.

julia.maxConcurrentIndexingProcesses.markdownDescription: Maximum number of concurrently running environment-indexing child processes. Set to 0 for no limit.

julia.enableWorkspaceEnvironmentResoluti.markdownDescription: Whether to auto-resolve environments in the workspace, for example a `docs/Project.toml` that has no Manifest.toml. Resolution runs Pkg in a background child process and may access the network. If false, only environments with a Manifest.toml are considered. Changing this requires a restart of the language server.

julia_executable_path.description: Full path to the Julia executable (including the file itself).

repl_env_variables.description: Additional environmental variables for the Julia REPL.
